name: Asset Factory
description: A visual NEP-17 token studio for deterministic creator artifacts, exact wallet commitments, refresh recovery, and read-only Factory verification. Contract creation remains locked until the live Factory ABI and transaction lifecycle are certified.
description_zh: 可视化 NEP-17 代币发行工作室，支持确定性发行蓝图、精确钱包承诺、刷新恢复和只读 Factory 记录核对。独立工件流水线完成认证前，合约创建保持锁定。

aa.description: Template plans can be submitted by AA later, but this standalone app does not require AA.

tee.description: No private computation is required for deterministic asset planning.

neodid.description: Issuer identity can be layered on top by signing the generated template plan.
